newsitem.title: USA: Seagull Energy closes Esso Suez deal.
newsitem.headline: Seagull Energy closes Esso Suez deal.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said on Wednesday it has closed the $74 million acquisition of Esso Suez Inc and certain assets of Esso Egypt Ltd, giving the company a presence in Egypt.

Esso Suez holds a 100 percent interest in the East Zeit oil producing concession in the offshore Gulf of Suez, where current production net to the acquired Seagull interest averages between 4,000 and 5,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
Esso Egypt owns the entire working interest in the South Hurghada exploration concession located onshore on the coast of the Gulf of Suez approximately 250 miles southeast of Cairo, Seagull said.
Seagull said it estimates that the East Zeit production concession presently contains more than 17 million net barrels of proved oil reserves.
Substantial additional reserves are expected to result from exploitation drilling on several identified, multiple-zone reservoir locations, Seagull said.
Seagull funded the purchase by drawing on existing credit facilities.
